responses.fb_other: The task was very tedious, repetitive, and initially overwhelming, especially during the first chromatogram because there were so many detected peaks to review. After zooming in, I realized that many of them were just tiny bumps or weren't visible peaks at all and could simply be deleted, which made the task easier to understand. I also expected there to be a clearer stopping point rather than continuing with additional chromatograms until I chose to stop myself.
